This is a reverse-engineering benchmark. You are given a compiled binary and its documentation.
Your job is to write a new, original codebase from scratch that produces an executable with identical behavior.
You must figure out the behavior solely by running and interacting with the provided binary.
Writing original code based on observed behavior is the entire point of this benchmark.

Any approach that shortcuts this — finding existing source code, wrapping the binary,
or installing the original tool — does not count as a solution. It will be detected by an
automated judge, marked as a disqualification, and scored as a failure.
The trace will be posted to an online wall of shame.

<RULES>
## What is not allowed

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.
- Fetching source tarballs from project websites (e.g., `curl https://lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.0.tar.gz`)
- Using a package manager to download the project as a dependency and then reading its cached source (e.g., navigating into `~/.cargo/registry/src/` or `$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/`)
- Searching the web for the project's source code or implementation details

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)
- Writing a `compile.sh` that simply makes the provided binary executable (`chmod +x ./executable`) or copies it (`cp ./executable ./executable`)
- Building a binary whose main function shells out to an external tool (e.g., `Command::new("miniserve").args(args).exec()`)
- Re-linking prebuilt `.o` object files found in the workspace without writing new source code

### 3. Binary analysis of the provided executable

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace
</RULES>

 (r'^Traceback \(most recent call last\):', 'python'),

}

    p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable','-c',code], capture_output=True, env=env)

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/keys.py
import os, pty, select, termios, time, signal, sys
pid, fd = pty.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.execv('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'])
    os._exit(1)
buf=bytearray()
def rd(t=0.3):
    while True:
        r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t)
        if not r: return
        try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
        except OSError: return
        if not d: return
        buf.extend(d)
def show(label):
    print('--- %s' % label)
    print(repr(bytes(buf)))
rd(0.4)
os.write(fd, b'print(1)\n'); rd(0.4)   # run
os.write(fd, b'print(2)\n'); rd(0.4)
os.write(fd, b'\x1b[A'); rd(0.4)        # up arrow
show('after up')
os.write(fd, b'\x1b[B'); rd(0.4)        # down
show('after down')
os.write(fd, b'\x1b[A\x1b[A'); rd(0.4)
show('after up2')
os.write(fd, b'x'); rd(0.3)
show('after append x')
os.write(fd, b'\x01'); rd(0.3)          # ctrl-A home
show('after ctrl-a')
os.write(fd, b'\x05'); rd(0.3)          # ctrl-E end
show('after ctrl-e')
os.write(fd, b'\x7f'); rd(0.3)          # backspace
show('after backspace')
os.write(fd, b'\x1b[D'); rd(0.3)        # left
show('after left')
os.write(fd, b'Z'); rd(0.3)
show('after Z insert')
os.write(fd, b'\x03'); rd(0.4)          # ctrl-C
show('after ctrl-c')
os.write(fd, b'\x04'); rd(0.4)          # ctrl-D
show('after ctrl-d')
os.write(fd, b'\x1b[C'); rd(0.3)        # right
show('after right')
os.write(fd, b'\x1b[H'); rd(0.3)        # home
show('after home esc[H')
os.write(fd, b'\x1b[F'); rd(0.3)        # end
show('after end esc[F')

show('after delete')
os.write(fd, b'\x0c'); rd(0.3)          # ctrl-L
show('after ctrl-l')
os.write(fd, b'\x04'); rd(0.3)
show('after ctrl-d2')
os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)

actions.command:
cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/rcmd2.py
import os, pty, select, termios, time, signal, re
def t(cmds, label, wait=0.4):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.execv('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'])
        os._exit(1)
    buf=bytearray()
    def rd(t_=wait):
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t_)
            if not r: return False
            try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return True
            if not d: return True
            buf.extend(d)
    rd(0.4)
    a = termios.tcgetattr(fd); a[3] &= ~termios.ECHO; termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSANOW, a)
    eof = False
    for k in cmds:
        os.write(fd, k)
        if rd(0.45): eof=True; break
    rd(0.4)
    try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    except Exception: pass
    time.sleep(0.05)
    try: _, st = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
    except Exception: st = 0
    exited = bool(st) and os.WIFEXITED(st)
    code = os.WEXITSTATUS(st) if exited else None
    s = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]', b'', bytes(buf)).replace(b'\r',b'').decode()
    lines=[l for l in s.split('\n') if l.strip() and '>>>' not in l and not l.startswith('run universal')]
    print('%-32s eof=%s exited=%s code=%s -> %r' % (label, eof, exited, code, ' || '.join(lines)[-170:]))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
exec(open('/tmp/rcmd2.py').read())
for c in [':exit', ':quit', ':  exit', ':exit x', ':e xit', ':EXIT', ':', '::', ':lang zzz', ':detect off\n:exit']:
    t([':detect off\n'.encode(), (c+'\n').encode()], repr(c))
"

    time.sleep(0.05)

import os, pty, select, termios, time, re
def t(lines, label):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()

{"command": "cd /workspace && timeout 120 python3 -c "
import os, pty, select, termios, time, re
def t(lines, label, wait=1.0):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.execv('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'])
        os._exit(1)
    buf=bytearray()
    def rd(t_=wait):
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t_)
            if not r: return False
            try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return True
            if not d: return True
            buf.extend(d)
    rd(0.5)
    os.write(fd, b':detect off\n'); rd(0.4)
    for l in lines:
        os.write(fd, l.encode()); rd(wait)
    s = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]', b'', bytes(buf)).replace(b'\r',b'').decode()
    i = s.find('disabled')
    print('===', label, repr(s[i:]))
    os.kill(pid, 9); time.sleep(0.05)
    try: os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except Exception: pass
t(['import time\n','time.sleep(0.1)\n'], 'import time then sleep')
t(['len([1,2])\n'], 'len list')
""}

import os, pty, select, termios, time, re, sys
def wrapped(code, wait=1.0):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.execv('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'])
        os._exit(1)
    buf=bytearray()
    def rd(t_):
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t_)
            if not r: return False
            try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return True
            if not d: return True
            buf.extend(d)
    rd(0.4)
    os.write(fd, b':detect off\n'); rd(0.3)
    for pre in [b'import time\n', b'x = 1\n', b'def f(): return 42\n']:
        os.write(fd, pre); rd(0.6)
    os.write(fd, (code+'\n').encode()); rd(wait)
    os.write(fd, b'open(__file__).read()\n'); rd(wait)
    s = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]', b'', bytes(buf)).replace(b'\r',b'').decode()
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)

    time.sleep(0.05)
    try: os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except Exception: pass
    i = s.find('disabled')
    tail = s[i:] if i>=0 else s
    quotes = [mm.group(1) for mm in re.finditer(r"'((?:[^'\\]|\\.)*)'", tail)]
    content = quotes[-1].encode().decode('unicode_escape') if quotes else ''
    probe = '__run_value_4 = (' + code + ')'
    return probe in content
codes = sys.argv[1:]
for c in codes:
    print('%-36r -> %s' % (c, 'WRAP' if wrapped(c) else 'no'), flush=True)

import os, pty, select, termios, time, re, sys
PRE = [b'import time\n', b'x = 1\n', b'def f(*a, **k): return 42\n',
       b'println = f\n', b'printf = f\n', b'puts = f\n', b'echo = f\n',
       b'printx = 1\n', b'print1 = 1\n', b'Print = 1\n', b'PRINT = 1\n',
       b'pprint = f\n', b'p = 1\n', b'pp = 1\n', b'writeln = f\n', b'log = f\n']
def wrapped(code, wait=1.0):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.execv('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'])
        os._exit(1)
    buf=bytearray()
    def rd(t_):
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t_)
            if not r: return False
            try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return True
            if not d: return True
            buf.extend(d)
    rd(0.4)
    os.write(fd, b':detect off\n'); rd(0.3)
    for pre in PRE:
        os.write(fd, pre); rd(0.4)
    os.write(fd, (code+'\n').encode()); rd(wait)
    os.write(fd, b'open(__file__).read()\n'); rd(wait)
    s = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]', b'', bytes(buf)).replace(b'\r',b'').decode()
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except Exception: pass
    time.sleep(0.05)
    try: os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except Exception: pass
    i = s.find('disabled')
    tail = s[i:] if i>=0 else s
    quotes = [mm.group(1) for mm in re.finditer(r"'((?:[^'\\]|\\.)*)'", tail)]
    content = quotes[-1].encode().decode('unicode_escape') if quotes else ''
    vals = re.findall(r'__run_value_(\d+) = \((.*)\)\n', content)
    return any(v == code for _, v in vals), [v for _, v in vals]
codes = sys.argv[1:]
for c in codes:
    w, vals = wrapped(c)
    print('%-26r -> %-5s %r' % (c, 'WRAP' if w else 'no', vals[-2:]), flush=True)

import os, pty, select, termios, time, re
def t(code, label):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.execv('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'])
        os._exit(1)
    buf=bytearray()
    def rd(t_=1.0):
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t_)
            if not r: return False
            try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return True
            if not d: return True
            buf.extend(d)
    rd(0.4)
    os.write(fd, b':detect off\n'); rd(0.3)
    os.write(fd, (code+'\n').encode()); rd(0.8)
    os.write(fd, b'open(__file__).read()\n'); rd(0.8)
    s = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]', b'', bytes(buf)).replace(b'\r',b'').decode()
    os.kill(pid, 9)
    i = s.rfind('read()\n')
    print('%-14s -> %r' % (label, s[i:]))
t('f(1)   ', 'trailing spaces')
t('   f(1)', 'leading spaces')
"

import os, pty, select, termios, time, re
PRE = [b'import time\n', b'x = 1\n', b'a = 1\n', b'def f(*a, **k): return 42\n']
def run(code, wait=1.0):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.execv('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'])
        os._exit(1)
    buf=bytearray()
    def rd(t_):
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t_)
            if not r: return False
            try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return True
            if not d: return True
            buf.extend(d)
    rd(0.4)
    os.write(fd, b':detect off\n'); rd(0.3)
    for pre in PRE: os.write(fd, pre); rd(0.15)
    os.write(fd, (code+'\n').encode()); rd(wait)
    s = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]', b'', bytes(buf)).replace(b'\r',b'').decode()
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except Exception: pass
    time.sleep(0.05)
    try: os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except Exception: pass
    k = s.rfind('disabled')
    return s[k:][-90:]
for c in ['print ', 'print', 'print(1)', 'print()', 'f(1) ', 'f(1)\t', '  f(1)']:
    print('%-14r -> %r' % (c, run(c)), flush=True)
"

import os, pty, select, termios, time, re
def run(lang, lines, wait=0.8):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        env = dict(os.environ); env['PATH'] = '/tmp/sdump:' + env['PATH']
        os.execve('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'], env)
        os._exit(1)
    buf=bytearray()
    def rd(t_):
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t_)
            if not r: return False
            try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return True
            if not d: return True
            buf.extend(d)
    rd(0.4)
    os.write(fd, b':detect off\n'); rd(0.3)
    os.write(fd, (':lang %s\n'%lang).encode()); rd(0.4)
    for l in lines:
        os.write(fd, l.encode()); rd(wait)
    os.kill(pid, 9)
    time.sleep(0.05)
    try: os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except Exception: pass
for lang in ['perl','r','bash','lua','php']:
    try: os.remove('/tmp/cd.log')
    except: pass
    run(lang, ['1\n'])
    print('===', lang)
    print(open('/tmp/cd.log').read()[:600] if os.path.exists('/tmp/cd.log') else '(none)')
"

import os, pty, select, termios, time, re
def run(cmds, wait=0.8):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.execv('/workspace/executable', ['/workspace/executable'])
        os._exit(1)
    buf=bytearray()
    def rd(t_):
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],t_)
            if not r: return False
            try: d = os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return True
            if not d: return True
            buf.extend(d)
    rd(0.4)
    for c in cmds:
        os.write(fd, c.encode()); rd(wait)
    s = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]', b'', bytes(buf)).replace(b'\r',b'').decode()
    try: os.kill(pid, 9)
    except Exception: pass
    time.sleep(0.05)
    try: os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except Exception: pass
    i = s.find('commands.')
    return s[i:]
for lang in ['typescript','ruby','javascript','lua','perl','r','crystal','dart','swift','haskell','nim','zig','julia','elixir','groovy','php','kotlin','java','csharp','c','cpp','rust','go','bash']:
    o = run([':lang %s\n'%lang, '1\n'])
    lines=[l for l in o.split('\n') if l.strip() and '>>>' not in l and not l.startswith('run universal')]
    print('%-11s -> %r' % (lang, ' || '.join(lines)[:150]))
"

"""Interactive REPL with a small readline style line editor."""

import os
import re

import detect

ESC = '\x1b'

  :lang <id>            Switch to language <id>
  :detect on|off        Enable or disable auto language detection
  :reset                Reset the current language session
  :load <path>          Execute a file in the current language
  :exit, :quit          Leave the REPL
Any language id or alias works as a shortcut, e.g. :py, :cpp, :csharp, :php."""

STRIP_RE = re.compile(r'(["\'])(?:\\.|(?!\1).)*\1')


def needs_continuation(line):
    """True when the line ends in a way that expects more input."""
    stripped = STRIP_RE.sub('""', line)
    s = stripped.rstrip()
    if not s:
        return False
    if s.endswith(':'):
        return True
    for op, cl in (('(', ')'), ('[', ']'), ('{', '}')):
        if s.count(op) - s.count(cl) > 0:
            return True
    return False


class Editor:
    """Minimal single line editor writing ANSI sequences."""

    def __init__(self, out):
        self.out = out
        self.buffer = ''
        self.cursor = 0
        self.prompt = ''
        self.history = []
        self.hist_pos = None
        self.saved = ''

    def write(self, s):
        self.out.write(s)
        self.out.flush()

    def render(self):
        self.write('\r\x1b[K' + self.prompt + self.buffer +
                   '\r\x1b[%dC' % (len(self.prompt) + self.cursor))

    def set_prompt(self, p):
        self.prompt = p

    def reset(self):
        self.buffer = ''
        self.cursor = 0

    def insert(self, ch):
        self.buffer = self.buffer[:self.cursor] + ch + self.buffer[self.cursor:]
        self.cursor += 1
        self.render()

    def backspace(self):
        if self.cursor > 0:
            self.buffer = self.buffer[:self.cursor - 1] + self.buffer[self.cursor:]
            self.cursor -= 1
            self.render()

    def delete(self):
        if self.cursor < len(self.buffer):
            self.buffer = self.buffer[:self.cursor] + self.buffer[self.cursor + 1:]
            self.render()

    def left(self):
        if self.cursor > 0:
            self.cursor -= 1
            self.render()

    def right(self):
        if self.cursor < len(self.buffer):
            self.cursor += 1
            self.render()

    def home(self):
        self.cursor = 0
        self.render()

    def end(self):
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()

    def clear_screen(self):
        self.write('\x1b[H\x1b[J')
        self.render()

    def history_up(self):
        if not self.history:
            return
        if self.hist_pos is None:
            self.saved = self.buffer
            self.hist_pos = len(self.history) - 1
        elif self.hist_pos > 0:
            self.hist_pos -= 1
        else:
            return
        self.buffer = self.history[self.hist_pos]
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()

    def history_down(self):
        if self.hist_pos is None:
            return
        if self.hist_pos < len(self.history) - 1:
            self.hist_pos += 1
            self.buffer = self.history[self.hist_pos]
        else:
            self.hist_pos = None
            self.buffer = self.saved
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()


class Session:
    """Persistent per language session state."""

    def __init__(self, lang):
        self.lang = lang
        self.lines = []
        self.dir = None
        self.started = False

    def ensure(self):
        if self.dir is None:
            self.dir = self.lang.session_dir()
        return self.dir


def repl(initial_lang=None):
    out = sys.stdout
    err = sys.stderr
    if not sys.stdin.isatty():
        return 1
    fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
    out.write('run universal REPL. Type :help for commands.\n')
    out.flush()
    lang = initial_lang or runners.RUNNERS['python']
    auto = True
    editor = Editor(out)
    pending = []
    session = Session(lang)
    tty.setraw(fd)
    editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
    editor.set_prompt(lang.id + '>>> ')
    editor.render()
    while True:
        try:

                if not line and not pending:
                    editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                    editor.render()
                    continue

                continue
            if ch == '\x0c':

                continue
            if ch == '\x7f':
                editor.delete()
                continue
            if ch == '\x08':

                continue
            if ch == '\x1b':

                continue

            editor.insert(ch)
        if quit:

    attrs = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
    attrs[3] |= termios.ICANON | termios.ECHO | termios.ISIG
    termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSADRAIN, attrs)
    return 0


def handle_block(block, lang, session, auto, editor):
    """Execute one submitted block.  Returns 'exit', 'fatal' or None."""
    text = '\n'.join(block)
    editor.history.append(text)
    if len(block) == 1 and block[0].startswith(':'):
        return command(block[0], lang, session, editor)
    if auto:
        det = detect.detect(text)
        if det != lang.id:
            editor.out.write('[auto-detect] switching %s \u2192 %s\n' %
                             (lang.id, det))
            editor.out.flush()
            lang = runners.RUNNERS[det]
            session = Session(lang)
    try:
        session.lines.extend(block)
        exe = lang.session(session.lines)
        rc, ms = run_stages(lang, exe)
    except runners.RunError as e:
        sys.stderr.write(e.render())
        return 'fatal'
    if rc != 0:
        sys.stdout.write('[exit code %d] (%dms)\n' % (rc, ms))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return None


def run_stages(lang, stages):
    """Run a list of Exec stages, returning (rc, ms)."""
    total = 0
    rc = 0
    for exe in stages:
        for path, content in exe.files:
            runners.write(path, content)
        t0 = time.time()
        if exe.pipes:
            p = __import__('subprocess').Popen(exe.argv, cwd=exe.cwd)
            rc = p.wait()
        else:
            try:
                p = __import__('subprocess').run(exe.argv, cwd=exe.cwd,
                                                 capture_output=True)
            except FileNotFoundError as e:
                raise runners.RunError('failed to execute compiled binary %s'
                                       % exe.argv[0],
                                       'No such file or directory (os error 2)')
            rc = p.returncode
            if p.stdout:
                sys.stdout.buffer.write(p.stdout)
                sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
            if p.stderr:
                sys.stderr.buffer.write(p.stderr)
                sys.stderr.buffer.flush()
        total += int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        if rc != 0:
            break
    return rc, total


def command(line, lang, session, editor):
    toks = line.strip().split()
    cmd = toks[0]
    rest = line.strip()[len(cmd):].strip()
    if cmd in (':exit', ':quit') and not rest:
        return 'exit'
    if cmd == ':help':
        sys.stdout.write(HELP_TEXT + '\n')
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':languages':
        sys.stdout.write('available languages: %s\n' % languages.LANG_IDS_STR)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':lang':
        if not rest:
            sys.stdout.write('usage: :lang <language>\n')
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        name = rest.split()[0]
        new = None
        t = name.strip().lower()
        if t in runners.RUNNERS:
            new = runners.RUNNERS[t]
        else:
            for lid, l in runners.RUNNERS.items():
                if any(a.lower() == t for a in l.aliases):
                    new = l
                    break
        if new is None:
            sys.stderr.write("Error: language '%s' not supported. Available: "
                             '%s\n' % (t, languages.LANG_IDS_STR))
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return 'fatal'
        if new.id == lang.id:
            sys.stdout.write('already using %s\n' % lang.id)
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        sys.stdout.write('switched to %s\n' % new.id)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        lang.id = new.id
        session.lang = new
        session.lines = []
        session.dir = None
        return None
    if cmd == ':detect':
        if not rest:
            sys.stdout.write('auto-detect is %s\n' %
                             ('enabled' if AUTO[0] else 'disabled'))
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        arg = rest.split()[0].lower()
        if arg == 'on':
            AUTO[0] = True
            sys.stdout.write('auto-detect enabled\n')
        elif arg == 'off':
            AUTO[0] = False
            sys.stdout.write('auto-detect disabled\n')
        elif arg == 'toggle':
            AUTO[0] = not AUTO[0]
            sys.stdout.write('auto-detect %s\n' %
                             ('enabled' if AUTO[0] else 'disabled'))
        else:
            sys.stdout.write('usage: :detect <on|off|toggle>\n')
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':reset':
        session.lines = []
        sys.stdout.write("session for '%s' reset\n" % lang.id)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':load':
        if not rest:
            sys.stdout.write('usage: :load <path>\n')
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        path = rest.split()[0]
        try:
            with open(path) as fh:
                code = fh.read()
        except OSError:
            sys.stdout.write('unable to read %s\n' % path)
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        try:
            exe = lang.session(session.lines + [code])
            rc, ms = run_stages(lang, exe)
        except runners.RunError as e:
            sys.stderr.write(e.render())
            return 'fatal'
        if rc != 0:
            sys.stdout.write('[exit code %d] (%dms)\n' % (rc, ms))
            sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    sys.stdout.write('unknown command: %s. Type :help for help.\n' % cmd)
    sys.stdout.flush()
    return None

"""Interactive REPL with a small readline style line editor."""

import os
import re
import select
import sys
import termios
import time
import tty

import detect
import expr
import languages
import runners

ESC = '\x1b'

HELP_TEXT = """Commands:
  :help                 Show this help message
  :languages            List available languages
  :lang <id>            Switch to language <id>
  :detect on|off        Enable or disable auto language detection
  :reset                Reset the current language session
  :load <path>          Execute a file in the current language
  :exit, :quit          Leave the REPL
Any language id or alias works as a shortcut, e.g. :py, :cpp, :csharp, :php."""

STRIP_RE = re.compile(r'(["\'])(?:\\.|(?!\1).)*\1')


def needs_continuation(line):
    """True when the line ends in a way that expects more input."""
    stripped = STRIP_RE.sub('""', line)
    s = stripped.rstrip()
    if not s:
        return False
    if s.endswith(':'):
        return True
    for op, cl in (('(', ')'), ('[', ']'), ('{', '}')):
        if s.count(op) - s.count(cl) > 0:
            return True
    return False


class Editor:
    """Minimal single line editor writing ANSI sequences."""

    def __init__(self, out):
        self.out = out
        self.buffer = ''
        self.cursor = 0
        self.prompt = ''
        self.history = []
        self.hist_pos = None
        self.saved = ''

    def write(self, s):
        self.out.write(s)
        self.out.flush()

    def render(self):
        self.write('\r\x1b[K' + self.prompt + self.buffer +
                   '\r\x1b[%dC' % (len(self.prompt) + self.cursor))

    def set_prompt(self, p):
        self.prompt = p

    def reset(self):
        self.buffer = ''
        self.cursor = 0

    def insert(self, ch):
        self.buffer = self.buffer[:self.cursor] + ch + self.buffer[self.cursor:]
        self.cursor += 1
        self.render()

    def backspace(self):
        if self.cursor > 0:
            self.buffer = self.buffer[:self.cursor - 1] + self.buffer[self.cursor:]
            self.cursor -= 1
            self.render()

    def delete(self):
        if self.cursor < len(self.buffer):
            self.buffer = self.buffer[:self.cursor] + self.buffer[self.cursor + 1:]
            self.render()

    def left(self):
        if self.cursor > 0:
            self.cursor -= 1
            self.render()

    def right(self):
        if self.cursor < len(self.buffer):
            self.cursor += 1
            self.render()

    def home(self):
        self.cursor = 0
        self.render()

    def end(self):
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()

    def clear_screen(self):
        self.write('\x1b[H\x1b[J')
        self.render()

    def history_up(self):
        if not self.history:
            return
        if self.hist_pos is None:
            self.saved = self.buffer
            self.hist_pos = len(self.history) - 1
        elif self.hist_pos > 0:
            self.hist_pos -= 1
        else:
            return
        self.buffer = self.history[self.hist_pos]
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()

    def history_down(self):
        if self.hist_pos is None:
            return
        if self.hist_pos < len(self.history) - 1:
            self.hist_pos += 1
            self.buffer = self.history[self.hist_pos]
        else:
            self.hist_pos = None
            self.buffer = self.saved
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()


class Session:
    """Persistent per language session state."""

    def __init__(self, lang):
        self.lang = lang
        self.lines = []
        self.dir = None
        self.started = False

    def ensure(self):
        if self.dir is None:
            self.dir = self.lang.session_dir()
        return self.dir


def repl(initial_lang=None):
    out = sys.stdout
    err = sys.stderr
    if not sys.stdin.isatty():
        return 1
    fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
    out.write('run universal REPL. Type :help for commands.\n')
    out.flush()
    lang = initial_lang or runners.RUNNERS['python']
    auto = True
    editor = Editor(out)
    pending = []
    session = Session(lang)
    tty.setraw(fd)
    editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
    editor.set_prompt(lang.id + '>>> ')
    editor.render()
    while True:
        try:
            data = os.read(fd, 4096)
        except OSError:
            break
        if not data:
            break
        quit = False
        for ch in data.decode('utf-8', 'replace'):
            if ch == '\n' or ch == '\r':
                line = editor.buffer
                editor.write('\x1b[?2004l\r\n')
                block = pending + ([line] if line else [])
                if not line and not pending:
                    editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                    editor.render()
                    continue
                if line and needs_continuation(line):
                    pending = block
                    editor.reset()
                    editor.set_prompt('... ')
                    editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                    editor.render()
                    continue
                pending = []
                editor.reset()
                res = handle_block(block, lang, session, auto, editor)
                if res == 'exit':
                    quit = True
                    break
                if res == 'fatal':
                    tty.setraw(fd) if False else None
                    os.write(fd, b'')
                    import termios as _t
                    attrs = _t.tcgetattr(fd)
                    attrs[3] |= _t.ICANON | _t.ECHO | _t.ISIG
                    _t.tcsetattr(fd, _t.TCSADRAIN, attrs)
                    return 1
                editor.set_prompt(lang.id + '>>> ')
                editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                editor.render()
                continue
            if ch == '\x03':
                editor.write('\x1b[?2004l\r\n^C\r\n')
                editor.reset()
                editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                editor.render()
                continue
            if ch == '\x04':
                if not editor.buffer:
                    editor.write('\x1b[?2004l\r\nbye\r\n')
                    quit = True
                    break
                continue
            if ch == '\x0c':
                editor.clear_screen()
                continue
            if ch == '\x7f':
                editor.delete()
                continue
            if ch == '\x08':
                editor.backspace()
                continue
            if ch == '\x1b':
                continue
            if ch == '\t':
                editor.insert('\t')
                continue
            if ord(ch) < 32:
                continue
            editor.insert(ch)
        if quit:
            break
    attrs = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
    attrs[3] |= termios.ICANON | termios.ECHO | termios.ISIG
    termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSADRAIN, attrs)
    return 0


def handle_block(block, lang, session, auto, editor):
    """Execute one submitted block.  Returns 'exit', 'fatal' or None."""
    text = '\n'.join(block)
    editor.history.append(text)
    if len(block) == 1 and block[0].startswith(':'):
        return command(block[0], lang, session, editor)
    if auto:
        det = detect.detect(text)
        if det != lang.id:
            editor.out.write('[auto-detect] switching %s \u2192 %s\n' %
                             (lang.id, det))
            editor.out.flush()
            lang = runners.RUNNERS[det]
            session = Session(lang)
    try:
        session.lines.extend(block)
        exe = lang.session(session.lines)
        rc, ms = run_stages(lang, exe)
    except runners.RunError as e:
        sys.stderr.write(e.render())
        return 'fatal'
    if rc != 0:
        sys.stdout.write('[exit code %d] (%dms)\n' % (rc, ms))

"""Interactive REPL with a small readline style line editor."""

import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import termios
import time
import tty

import detect
import languages
import runners
from main import RunError, run_stages, deno_message, RAW_SPAWN_ERROR

HELP_TEXT = """Commands:
  :help                 Show this help message
  :languages            List available languages
  :lang <id>            Switch to language <id>
  :detect on|off        Enable or disable auto language detection
  :reset                Reset the current language session
  :load <path>          Execute a file in the current language
  :exit, :quit          Leave the REPL
Any language id or alias works as a shortcut, e.g. :py, :cpp, :csharp, :php."""

STRIP_RE = re.compile(r'(["\'])(?:\\.|(?!\1).)*\1')


def needs_continuation(line):
    stripped = STRIP_RE.sub('""', line)
    s = stripped.rstrip()
    if not s:
        return False
    if s.endswith(':'):
        return True
    for op, cl in (('(', ')'), ('[', ']'), ('{', '}')):
        if s.count(op) - s.count(cl) > 0:
            return True
    return False


class Editor:
    def __init__(self, out):
        self.out = out
        self.buffer = ''
        self.cursor = 0
        self.prompt = ''
        self.history = []
        self.hist_pos = None
        self.saved = ''

    def write(self, s):
        self.out.write(s)
        self.out.flush()

    def render(self):
        self.write('\r\x1b[K' + self.prompt + self.buffer +
                   '\r\x1b[%dC' % (len(self.prompt) + self.cursor))

    def reset(self):
        self.buffer = ''
        self.cursor = 0

    def insert(self, ch):
        self.buffer = self.buffer[:self.cursor] + ch + self.buffer[self.cursor:]
        self.cursor += 1
        self.render()

    def backspace(self):
        if self.cursor > 0:
            self.buffer = (self.buffer[:self.cursor - 1] +
                           self.buffer[self.cursor:])
            self.cursor -= 1
            self.render()

    def delete(self):
        if self.cursor < len(self.buffer):
            self.buffer = (self.buffer[:self.cursor] +
                           self.buffer[self.cursor + 1:])
            self.render()

    def left(self):
        if self.cursor > 0:
            self.cursor -= 1
            self.render()

    def right(self):
        if self.cursor < len(self.buffer):
            self.cursor += 1
            self.render()

    def home(self):
        self.cursor = 0
        self.render()

    def end(self):
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()

    def clear_screen(self):
        self.write('\x1b[H\x1b[J')
        self.render()

    def history_up(self):
        if not self.history:
            return

    def write(self, s):
        self.out.write(s)
        self.out.flush()

    def render(self):
        self.write('\r\x1b[K' + self.prompt + self.buffer +
                   '\r\x1b[%dC' % (len(self.prompt) + self.cursor))

    def reset(self):
        self.buffer = ''
        self.cursor = 0

    def insert(self, ch):
        self.buffer = self.buffer[:self.cursor] + ch + self.buffer[self.cursor:]
        self.cursor += 1
        self.render()

    def backspace(self):
        if self.cursor > 0:
            self.buffer = (self.buffer[:self.cursor - 1] +
                           self.buffer[self.cursor:])
            self.cursor -= 1
            self.render()

    def delete(self):
        if self.cursor < len(self.buffer):
            self.buffer = (self.buffer[:self.cursor] +
                           self.buffer[self.cursor + 1:])
            self.render()

    def left(self):
        if self.cursor > 0:
            self.cursor -= 1
            self.render()

    def right(self):
        if self.cursor < len(self.buffer):
            self.cursor += 1
            self.render()

    def home(self):
        self.cursor = 0
        self.render()

    def end(self):
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()

    def clear_screen(self):
        self.write('\x1b[H\x1b[J')
        self.render()

    def history_up(self):
        if not self.history:
            return
        if self.hist_pos is None:
            self.saved = self.buffer
            self.hist_pos = len(self.history) - 1
        elif self.hist_pos > 0:
            self.hist_pos -= 1
        else:
            return
        self.buffer = self.history[self.hist_pos]
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()

    def history_down(self):
        if self.hist_pos is None:
            return
        if self.hist_pos < len(self.history) - 1:
            self.hist_pos += 1
            self.buffer = self.history[self.hist_pos]
        else:
            self.hist_pos = None
            self.buffer = self.saved
        self.cursor = len(self.buffer)
        self.render()


class Session:
    def __init__(self, lang):
        self.lang = lang
        self.lines = []
        self.dir = None

    def reset(self):
        self.lines = []
        self.dir = None


def resolve(name):
    t = name.strip().lower()
    if t in runners.RUNNERS:
        return runners.RUNNERS[t]
    for lid, l in runners.RUNNERS.items():
        if any(a.lower() == t for a in l.aliases):
            return l
    return None


def repl(initial_lang=None):
    if not sys.stdin.isatty():
        return 1
    fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
    out = sys.stdout
    err = sys.stderr
    out.write('run universal REPL. Type :help for commands.\n')
    out.flush()
    lang = initial_lang or runners.RUNNERS['python']
    auto = [True]
    editor = Editor(out)
    pending = []
    session = Session(lang)
    tty.setraw(fd)
    editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
    editor.set_prompt(lang.id + '>>> ')
    editor.render()
    quit = False
    fatal = False
    while not quit and not fatal:
        try:
            data = os.read(fd, 4096)
        except OSError:
            break
        if not data:
            break
        text = data.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
        i = 0
        n = len(text)
        while i < n:
            ch = text[i]
            i += 1
            if ch == '\n' or ch == '\r':
                line = editor.buffer
                editor.write('\x1b[?2004l\r\n')
                if not line and not pending:
                    editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                    editor.render()
                    break
                block = pending + ([line] if line else [])
                if line and needs_continuation(line):
                    pending = block
                    editor.reset()
                    editor.set_prompt('... ')
                    editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                    editor.render()
                    break
                pending = []
                editor.reset()
                res = handle_block(block, lang, session, auto, editor)
                if isinstance(res, tuple):
                    lang = res[0]
                    session = res[1]
                elif res == 'exit':
                    quit = True
                    break
                elif res == 'fatal':
                    fatal = True
                    break
                editor.set_prompt(lang.id + '>>> ')
                editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                editor.render()
                break
            if ch == '\x1b':
                seq = text[i - 1:]
                if seq.startswith('\x1b[A'):
                    editor.history_up()
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if seq.startswith('\x1b[B'):
                    editor.history_down()
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if seq.startswith('\x1b[C'):
                    editor.right()
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if seq.startswith('\x1b[D'):
                    editor.left()
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if seq.startswith('\x1b[H'):
                    editor.home()
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if seq.startswith('\x1b[F'):
                    editor.end()
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if seq.startswith('\x1b[3~'):
                    editor.delete()
                    i += 3
                    continue
                if seq.startswith('\x1b[200~'):
                    j = text.find('\x1b[201~', i)
                    if j < 0:
                        break
                    for c in text[i:j]:
                        editor.insert(c)
                    i = j + 5
                    continue
                continue
            if ch == '\x03':
                editor.write('\x1b[?2004l\r\n^C\r\n')
                editor.reset()
                editor.write('\x1b[?2004h')
                editor.render()
                continue
            if ch == '\x04':
                if not editor.buffer:
                    editor.write('\x1b[?2004l\r\nbye\r\n')
                    quit = True
                    break
                continue
            if ch == '\x0c':
                editor.clear_screen()
                continue
            if ch == '\x7f':
                editor.delete()
                continue
            if ch == '\x08':
                editor.backspace()
                continue
            if ch == '\t':
                editor.insert('\t')
                continue
            if ord(ch) < 32:
                continue
            editor.insert(ch)
    attrs = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
    attrs[3] |= termios.ICANON | termios.ECHO | termios.ISIG
    termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSADRAIN, attrs)
    return 1 if fatal else 0


def handle_block(block, lang, session, auto, editor):
    """Execute one submitted block."""
    text = '\n'.join(block)
    editor.history.append(text)
    if len(block) == 1 and block[0].lstrip().startswith(':'):
        res = command(block[0], lang, session, auto, editor)
        return res
    if auto[0]:
        det = detect.detect(text)
        if det != lang.id:
            editor.out.write('[auto-detect] switching %s \u2192 %s\n' %
                             (lang.id, det))
            editor.out.flush()
            lang = runners.RUNNERS[det]
            session = Session(lang)
    session.lines.extend(block)
    try:
        check(lang)
        rc, ms = run_stages(lang, lang.session(session.lines))
    except RunError as e:
        sys.stderr.write(e.render())
        sys.stderr.flush()
        return 'fatal'
    if rc != 0:
        sys.stdout.write('[exit code %d] (%dms)\n' % (rc, ms))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return None


def check(lang):
    import main as m
    m.check_availability(lang, 'repl')


def command(line, lang, session, auto, editor):
    stripped = line.strip()
    toks = stripped.split()
    cmd = toks[0]
    rest = stripped[len(cmd):].strip()
    if cmd in (':exit', ':quit'):
        if not rest:
            return 'exit'
        sys.stdout.write('unknown command: %s. Type :help for help.\n' % cmd)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':help':
        sys.stdout.write(HELP_TEXT + '\n')
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':languages':
        sys.stdout.write('available languages: %s\n' % languages.LANG_IDS_STR)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':lang':
        if not rest:
            sys.stdout.write('usage: :lang <language>\n')
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        new = resolve(rest.split()[0])
        if new is None:
            sys.stderr.write("Error: language '%s' not supported. Available: "
                             '%s\n' % (rest.split()[0].strip().lower(),
                                       languages.LANG_IDS_STR))
            sys.stderr.flush()
            return 'fatal'
        if new.id == lang.id:
            sys.stdout.write('already using %s\n' % lang.id)
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        sys.stdout.write('switched to %s\n' % new.id)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        session.lang = new
        session.lines = []
        session.dir = None
        return (new, session)
    if cmd == ':detect':
        if not rest:
            sys.stdout.write('auto-detect is %s\n' %
                             ('enabled' if auto[0] else 'disabled'))
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        arg = rest.split()[0].lower()
        if arg == 'on':
            auto[0] = True
            sys.stdout.write('auto-detect enabled\n')
        elif arg == 'off':
            auto[0] = False
            sys.stdout.write('auto-detect disabled\n')
        elif arg == 'toggle':
            auto[0] = not auto[0]
            sys.stdout.write('auto-detect %s\n' %
                             ('enabled' if auto[0] else 'disabled'))
        else:
            sys.stdout.write('usage: :detect <on|off|toggle>\n')
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':reset':
        session.reset()
        sys.stdout.write("session for '%s' reset\n" % lang.id)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    if cmd == ':load':
        if not rest:
            sys.stdout.write('usage: :load <path>\n')
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        path = rest.split()[0]
        try:
            with open(path) as fh:
                code = fh.read()
        except OSError:
            sys.stdout.write('unable to read %s\n' % path)
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return None
        try:
            check(lang)
            rc, ms = run_stages(lang, lang.session(session.lines + [code]))
        except RunError as e:
            sys.stderr.write(e.render())
            sys.stderr.flush()
            return 'fatal'
        if rc != 0:
            sys.stdout.write('[exit code %d] (%dms)\n' % (rc, ms))
            sys.stdout.flush()
        return None
    sys.stdout.write('unknown command: %s. Type :help for help.\n' % cmd)
    sys.stdout.flush()
    return None
